name: the-creed-of-life
description: The Creed of Life — offline Android APK contour (Stage 2)

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android && npm run generate:assets
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.test:ui: node tests/html-structure.test.js && node tests/enum-picker.test.js && node tests/settings-ui.test.js
scripts.test:ai: node tests/ai-flow.test.js && node tests/ai-worker.test.js && node tests/ai-equipment-slots.test.js
scripts.test:all: node tests/storage-reliability.test.js && node tests/capacitor-bridge.test.js && node tests/mobile-ux.test.js && node tests/offline-readiness.test.js && npm run test:ui && npm run test:ai
scripts.cap:build:unix: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:assets: npm run generate:assets && npx cap sync android
